title: Associate - Technology Consulting, Data and Artificial Intelligence (2026 Graduates)
job_description: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. Are you ready to shape the future with confidence? The Opportunity: The Data and Artificial Intelligence team works collaboratively with our clients to manage engagements and lead teams of data analysis resources in all aspects of design and delivery of information solutions. Currently they are looking out for students who are interested to become a data engineer. Data and Artificial Intelligence is integrated into all Consulting service offerings and assists clients to leverage data as an asset throughout its business processes. You'll enjoy working in multi-disciplinary teams and gaining valuable experience in various sectors and play a key role in ensuring high quality outputs and service to our clients. Your Key Responsibilities Contribute technically and deliver Analytics-related solutions to clients Communicate effectively with the project manager & team members regarding the progress of the project Prepare technological solutions, reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other parties Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel Build strong internal relationships within Ernst & Young Consulting Services and with other services across the organization Skills and Attributes for Success: Degree in quantitative fields such as Computing, Engineering, Analytics, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Machine Learning, Operation Research, Information Management Good understanding of time series, statistical, and decision modeling; and machine learning techniques Good understanding of various data structures, common methods and tools used for data transformation Proficiency with analytical programming languages such as Python and/or R, as well as familiarity with SQL Familiarity with at least one marketable business intelligence tool, such as PowerBI Familiarity with cloud technologies, DevOps tools, ETL tools, machine learning frameworks, visualization software, * Unix shell scripting are considered a plus. Comfortable with ambiguity and applying creativity to solve complex problems Some data competition experiences are preferred Note: You are required to upload your latest resume and academic transcripts together with your online application. We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. To learn more about careers in EY, please visit Careers at EY or connect with us on social media (Facebook or Instagram) to hear from our people about their EY careers. EY | Building a better working world EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
